messages:
yasmin: Found a config in prod that says `version: 1.0.0.0.0.0.1-beta-ish`
morgan: lol what did the YAML do to deserve that
devon: probably trying to be semver, ended up a sandwich
samir: paste? curious if there's also a `---\n` salad hiding
yasmin: here —\n```yaml\nservice:\n  name: spinach-service\n  version: 1.0.0.0.0.0.1-beta-ish\n  enable: true\n```\n(mood: :face_with_monocle:)
morgan: bravo. Also if you prefix with `v` it's an elder patch now
devon: the compiler reacted: `warning: existential versioning detected` :laughing:
ops-bot: Deploy scheduled at 10:00 — note: version string not validated by schema (reaction: :wrench:)
samir: new rule: any version with more than 3 dots is considered 'abstract art' and must get an artist's statement
yasmin: can we add a lint rule to reject that pattern? maybe a regex: `^\dv?\d+\.\d+\.\d+(-[a-z0-9]+)?$`
morgan: or just accept it's a YAML punk rock phase and move on :guitar:
devon: also found a comment: `# semver is for people who like rules` — I respect the honesty
samir: I'm campaigning for a special emoji reaction for 'semver trauma' :bandaged_heart:
yasmin: PR opened: `lint/ban-elliptical-versions` — will add tests and a punny commit message
morgan: commits should be: `fix: stop confusing the parser, feed it dignity` :thumbsup:
devon: can we also start a compiler-only breakfast club? bring muffins, complain about whitespace
yasmin: agreed. I will bring YAML jokes. Who's doing the coffee? (cc @morgan)
morgan: on coffee. will bring decaf for the brave
